mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are clear near Harriet Park with a temperature of 64 degrees and a waxing crescent moon above.

The City of Verona has officially adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan following a unanimous vote. This long-term guide aims to develop sustainable neighborhoods, boost our local economy, and improve infrastructure over the coming decades.

There is plenty to do this week. Today you can join Hop Haus for trivia, while tomorrow brings the Verona Downtown Farmers Market, yoga at Insight Wellness, and trivia nights at both The Mill and The Bogey Factory.
Looking at the recent police report, on September 28, officers handled a motor vehicle crash involving a 16-year-old operating an electric motorcycle recklessly, resulting in multiple citations.
For dessert lovers, today's flavor is Oreo Cookie Cheesecake. The restaurant opens today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by and grab a scoop.
